placementMethod: Uniform cover fit, centered in original source rectangle; no warping or color/lighting adjustments.
joinMethod: Later crop overlays opaque earlier crop using a native linear source-overlap alpha mask intersected with unchanged source silhouette.
visualReviewNotes: Reviewed native reopened close face portrait. Eye color/makeup, pale skin, lips, red hood ridges and ornament are coherent with the master and selected source crop; single-crop assembly preserves the exact source framing and silhouette.
deliveryExport: Native Photoshop Save for Web, PNG24, embedded sRGB ICC. Export-only profile conversion from the native working profile; no document changes or grading.
